page.overview:
Who is Masachika Kumeno?

Masachika was a young man with an average build and short, spiky black hair. He had noticeably small, rounded eyebrows and two prominent scars on his left cheek. His mouth was usually curved into a happy smile.

Masachika wore the standard Demon Slayer uniform that consisted of a dark gakuran jacket, white belt, and baggy hakama pants tucked into white wraps of cloth around his ankles.

In Kimetsu Gakuen!, his eyes are olive green with white diamond-shaped pupils.

Masachika was a very kind person, befriending Sanemi and even introducing him to someone who could help train him. In stark contrast to Sanemi's ill-tempered and rude behavior, Masachika is also shown to have a jolly and high-spirited personality. He frequently teased Sanemi by inviting him to eat out, imploring him to view him as his big brother, and poking fun at Sanemi's recklessness and cluelessness to romance. Masachika was also very sociable and charismatic, telling Shinobu Kocho a humorous tale about Gyomei Himejima being chased for playing the flute too loud and fondness for cats, and endearing himself to a grumpy old man with his exuberant charm, making the man retell the story of "Yae".
